title: Matrix change file
description: The matrix changes one step makes, written to one file and applied in one locked update of the matrix (matrixwrite.apply_change_file, atw-matrix apply --file). Each operation takes the arguments of the atw-matrix sub-command it is named for. The file is applied whole or not at all: when any operation fails, nothing is written and every failure is reported with its operation's index.

operations.description: The operations, applied in order, each to the matrix as the operations before it left it.

Attributes.description: Attributes by the name the kinds registry declares (matrix-kinds.json); null removes one.

Put.description: Add or change one entry: atw-matrix put.

id.description: The entry's id; absent builds it from the kind and the name.

name.description: The entry's name; needed for an entry that is new.

aliases.description: Other names the entry is known by; added to those held.

removeAliases.description: Aliases to remove from the entry.

purpose.description: One or two sentences that identify the entry.

stack.description: The stack that holds a repository-side component, infrastructure or layer; it builds the id.

publishedBy.description: The service or component that publishes an event the architecture side records.

unset.description: The names of the attributes to remove from the entry.

Link.description: Add one relationship or change its attributes: atw-matrix link.

Unlink.description: Remove one relationship as one side states it: atw-matrix unlink. The attributes name the kind's key attributes, such as the heading of a describedBy.

Settle.description: Record which statement of a disagreement stands: atw-matrix settle.

stands.description: The document (its id, or its path under the architecture root) and the heading of the statement that stands.

rule.description: The rule the ruling was made by.

reason.description: Why, when the rule does not say it all.
